Predictions & assumptions

Route is a user-supplied planned route, not a recorded passage. Default speed is applied except for an approximate slow section at Shinnecock Canal. Slow zones, bridge inventory, clearance and local station assignments are incomplete. NOAA predictions are queried directly for Moriches Coast Guard Station and interpolated between six-minute values. Tide heights are not water depths. Conditions can differ from predictions.
